headline: BIS Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment Controls
snippet: amends the EAR to implement SME controls more effectively and to address ongoing national security concerns.

headline: CHIPS Act Foreign Entity Funding Limits
snippet: prohibiting engagement in certain significant transactions involving the material expansion of semiconductor manufacturing capacity in foreign countries of concern

headline: Section 301 China Semiconductor Tariff Action
snippet: appropriate responsive action includes taking tariff action now on semiconductors from China, with an initial tariff level of 0 percent, increasing in 18 months

headline: Section 301 China Chip Dominance Probe
snippet: investigation of China's acts, policies, and practices related to targeting of the semiconductor industry for dominance

headline: BIS Advanced Computing Export Rule Briefing
snippet: Refinements to Controls for Advanced Computing and Semiconductor Manufacturing Items

headline: BIS Entity List Expansion on Chip Firms
snippet: All of these entities...are involved with the development and production of "advanced-node integrated circuits"...and/or semiconductor manufacturing items

headline: VEU Rules Tightened for Samsung, SK Hynix China
snippet: BIS amends the EAR to revise the existing Validated End-User (VEU) list...for Samsung China Semiconductor Co. Ltd. and SK hynix Semiconductor (China) Ltd.

headline: New Foreign Direct Product Rule on Chip Equipment
snippet: BIS makes changes to the EAR controls for certain advanced computing items...creating new Foreign Direct Product (FDP) rules...adding new controls for certain high bandwidth memory

headline: BIS Corrects 2023 Chip Export Control Rules
snippet: This rule corrects inadvertent errors in those rules and makes additional clarifications for the two rules.

headline: Section 301 Tariff Hike on Wafers, Polysilicon
snippet: propose increasing tariff rates for certain tungsten products, wafers, and polysilicon

headline: CHIPS Act Investment Credit Final Rules
snippet: final regulations to implement the advanced manufacturing investment credit established by the CHIPS Act of 2022 to incentivize the manufacture of semiconductors

headline: BIS Due Diligence Rule for Advanced Chip ICs
snippet: BIS is revising the EAR...to provide additional due diligence procedures regarding advanced computing integrated circuits (ICs)

headline: BIS Refines 2022 Chip Export Controls on China
snippet: These revisions protect U.S. national security interests by further restricting China's ability to obtain critical technologies to modernize its military capabilities

headline: Section 232 Semiconductor Import Tariffs
snippet: Adjusting Imports of Semiconductors, Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, and Their Derivative Products Into the United States

headline: China Chip VEU Authorization Revoked
snippet: removing Intel Semiconductor (Dalian) Ltd; Samsung China Semiconductor Co. Ltd; and SK hynix Semiconductor (China) Ltd

headline: Section 232 Chip Import Investigation
snippet: initiated an investigation to determine the effects on the national security of imports of semiconductors and semiconductor manufacturing equipment

headline: Advanced Computing Chip License Easing
snippet: changing it from a presumption of denial to a case-by-case review...Nvidia H200 and its equivalents

headline: New Export Controls on Advanced Chip Tech
snippet: implementing export controls on several semiconductor, quantum, and additive manufacturing items for national security and foreign policy reasons

headline: Semiconductor Export Control Comment Extension
snippet: extends the deadline for submission of written comments on both rules to January 17, 2024

headline: US-UAE AI Chip Export Easing
snippet: license-free access to advanced computing items, consistent with the May 2025 U.S.-UAE Artificial Intelligence Cooperation framework

headline: Domestic Chip Manufacturing Procurement RFI
snippet: seeks input on ways the Federal Government can build the resilience of domestic semiconductor manufacturing

headline: FAR Ban on Certain Semiconductor Procurement
snippet: prohibits executive agencies from procuring or obtaining certain products and services that include covered semiconductor products
